verdict.rationale: Kick ships first-party MCP connectors for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and custom tools. Its docs explicitly say users can look things up, make changes, and run reports using natural language, with bookkeeping changes subject to approval. The natural-language layer comes from an external MCP-compatible assistant rather than a native in-app chat. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language interface, independent or hands-on corroboration of how reliable NL-driven operations are, detailed tool-level coverage limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
